# Tabitha Pratt

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v5 c1 P1](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0001), [v5 c1 P2](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0002)</sub>
- **Role:** Servant  <sub>[v5 c1 P0](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Tabitha is described as a scrawny, gray, and sensible woman.

_Sources: [v5 c1 P0](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0000), [v5 c30 P14](../source/v05-c30.md#nw-v05-c30-p0014)_

## Personality

Tabitha is an austere, fierce, and unbothered woman who possesses a solid sense of practicality and common sense. She is utterly devoted and loyal to the Carrow family, holding absolute authority within the Hollowmere household.

_Sources: [v5 c1 P0](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0000), [v5 c1 P7](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0007), [v4 c19 P5](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0005), [v5 c30 P17](../source/v05-c30.md#nw-v05-c30-p0017)_

## Traits

- Austere  <sub>[v5 c1 P0](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0000)</sub>
- Fierce  <sub>[v4 c19 P5](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0005)</sub>
- Practical and unbothered by ghost stories  <sub>[v5 c30 P17](../source/v05-c30.md#nw-v05-c30-p0017), [v5 c30 P22](../source/v05-c30.md#nw-v05-c30-p0022)</sub>
- Fear of the children poisoning themselves  <sub>[v5 c3 P11](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0011)</sub>

## Abilities

- Cooking and baking  <sub>[v5 c1 P6](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0006)</sub>
- Infant and child care  <sub>[v5 c1 P4](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0004), [v5 c1 P5](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0005)</sub>

## History

Tabitha entered service as a gray, austere servant at Hollowmere for the Carrow household. When Nell fell gravely ill after giving birth to her infant son Harcourt, Tabitha took complete charge of caring for the baby, forming an intense maternal affection for him that led her to shield him fiercely from any physical discipline. During a three-month period when Dr. Carrow and Nell traveled to London, Tabitha cared for Harcourt at her brother's home while the other children went to Brierley. When Nell went into labor at the house of dreams, Tabitha helped manage the home and offered fierce comfort during the uncertain ordeal. On another occasion when the Ashdown children fled in terror from a supposed phantom, Tabitha marched out into Fern Hollow armed with a pitchfork to investigate, uncovering that the ghost was merely old Mrs. Stimson retrieving bleached cotton sheets from an embankment.

_Sources: [v5 c1 P0](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0000), [v5 c1 P4](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0004), [v5 c1 P5](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0005), [v5 c1 P7](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0007), [v4 c19 P0](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0000), [v4 c19 P5](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0005), [v5 c30 P17](../source/v05-c30.md#nw-v05-c30-p0017), [v5 c30 P23](../source/v05-c30.md#nw-v05-c30-p0023), [v5 c30 P25](../source/v05-c30.md#nw-v05-c30-p0025)_

## Quotes

> Mrs. Dr. dear, I brought him into this world every bit as much as you. The baby belongs to me every bit as much as he belongs to you.  <sub>[v5 c1 P5](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0005)</sub>

> Sweet Mrs. Dr., that fellow would whip a seraph, he surely would  <sub>[v5 c1 P6](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0006)</sub>

> Winifred Tolley is walking up the harbour road right now, Mrs. Dr. dear. She will be arriving here to dump three months’ worth of gossip upon us.  <sub>[v5 c1 P8](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0008)</sub>

> Never say that God would act with such cruelty as to rob us of that sweet lamb when each of us holds her so dear.  <sub>[v4 c19 P5](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0005)</sub>

> I have discovered what your phantom turned out to be  <sub>[v5 c30 P25](../source/v05-c30.md#nw-v05-c30-p0025)</sub>
